content.text: What's Holding You Back?: Design assets

If you're a digital creator who wants to take control of your online store and sell your digital products without relying on third-party platforms, what's holding you back? Is it fear of the unknown, lack of technical expertise, or something else? Whatever the reason, the Sovereign Stack is here to help you overcome those obstacles and build a sovereign digital commerce stack that's entirely yours to own and operate.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
With the Sovereign Stack, you can avoid platform fees and maintain complete ownership of your digital commerce infrastructure.
What's Next?

Now that you know the Sovereign Stack and how it can help you take control of your online store and sell your digital products without relying on third-party platforms, what's next? Will you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack today and start selling your digital products on your own terms? Whatever your next step is, remember that the Sovereign Stack is here to help you build a sovereign digital commerce stack that's entirely yours to own and operate.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.

The most important question you're likely asking is: how can I sell my digital products without giving up 10% of my sales to a platform fee? The answer is the Sovereign Stack, a fully operational online store that gives you complete ownership of your digital commerce infrastructure. With the Sovereign Stack, you can host, sell, and deliver your digital products without relying on a third-party platform, and at a fee of just 0.5% with NOWPayments.
For just $197, you can deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack with the Complete Builder Kit.

If you're searching for ways to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software without relying on third-party platforms, you're in luck. The Sovereign Stack is the solution you've been looking for. And if you're still unsure about how to deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, remember that the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all six blueprints and seven templates you need to get started. With the Complete Builder Kit, you can take control of your online store and sell your digital products on your own terms.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
